Population counting uses its cached explicit city/high-water count, excludes states0/2/5/6, and classifies signed levels/populations. Sentiment instead uses fixed house IDs1..3999 with exact state1 and nonzero occupancy/population gates.

Preserve signed/wrapped tax-band and labor arithmetic, unemployment thresholds, alternating food toggle, low-population exceptions and actual cohort removal. Do not import C# table-index clamping absent from the original.
Preserve native BYTE addition/wrap before signed happiness clamps, hunger-counter wrap before its cap, separate food/model denominators and the unweighted mean of signed house happiness values.

Retain strict worst-cause priority/ties and the previous stored cause when all factors are nonnegative. Preserve cached versus live city selection across labor, census, food-percentage, temple and both toast callbacks; secondary toast is computed before the first callback.
House adjustment caches the signed wrapped city delta before temple callbacks and clamps updated DWORDs after addition. All four obsolete frame bodies disappear from both final maps.
